articles.title: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro Just Made a Camera Change That Could Change Everything
articles.summary: Apple's new iPhone 18 Pro has a variable aperture camera—a first for iPhones—plus a blazing A20 Pro chip and up to 30 hours of battery. It's a big deal for photo fans.

articles.title: US Open Epic: Shelton Upsets Alcaraz in Latest Finish in Tournament History
articles.summary: Ben Shelton stunned Carlos Alcaraz in a five-set US Open quarter-final that ended at 3:34 AM—the latest finish ever. Shelton's first win over a top-three player sends him to the semis.

articles.title: First Denisovan Arm Bone Found in Chinese Cave Reveals 100,000 Years of History
articles.summary: In a Chinese cave, scientists found the first Denisovan arm bone ever, plus tools and animal bones. It shows Denisovans thrived there for 100,000 years, hunting big game.
